description: This file defines a React functional component StatusSummary that displays a live, summarized status of tasks across categories such as To Do, In Progress, Done, and On Hold. It uses context to retrieve card data and renders counts for each status category with real-time updates.

methods.name: StatusSummary()
methods.description: A React functional component that displays a summarized status overview of Kanban cards, including counts for each status category with live updates.
